create_llm_tensor_parallel: create an LLM instance with tensor_parallel_size and pipeline_parallel_size for distributed inference
run_torchrun_distributed_inference: run vLLM tensor-parallel inference using torchrun with external_launcher backend
generate_text_with_sampling_params: generate text from prompts using SamplingParams with temperature and top_p settings
get_world_group_cpu_group: get the cpu_group from vllm.distributed.parallel_state.get_world_group for cross-rank control messages
get_world_group_device_group: get the device_group from vllm.distributed.parallel_state.get_world_group for cross-rank data communication
